rows.grounds: compound locating the practice in the forehead's collection of letters/syllables; varṇa may denote letter or color
specifies the number of repetitions to be performed
absolutive indicating completion of the prescribed repetition
vocative address to the recipient or practitioner honored by the gods

items.question: What quantity of repetition in the forehead's letter-mass must the resolute practitioner complete?
premises: The practice is located in the mass of letters on the forehead.
The required act consists of a hundred thousand repetitions.
The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
items.inference: The resolute practitioner must complete a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the forehead's letter-mass.
uncertainties: Whether varṇa in the compound refers primarily to letters/syllables or to colors.
Whether the repetition is mental, vocal, or visualized within the forehead locus.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters on the forehead.
